## Checking SNPs
**x3_12288284, x14_94378610, x17_66214462, x19_19268740 were excluded from analysis**
```{r correlation of SNPs}
pfc_chem_summaries <-  data_hcc %>%
  dplyr::select(x1_220796686:x22_43928850) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = x1_220796686:x22_43928850) %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  summarise(pct_one_val   = mean(value == 0 | value == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
            variance = var(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean    = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE))

snp_name_df <-  tidylog::left_join(pfc_chem_summaries, 
                                   snp_info, by = c("name" = "snp_name")) |>
  tidylog::filter(pct_one_val < 0.75) #%>% 

snp_name_scld <- c(paste0(snp_name_df$name, "_scld"))
```

## Analysis 1: PRS risk score
```{r }
prs_frmla_no_int <- paste("status ~ pfas_lg2_PFHpA + prs_wt_median + v1 + v2 + v3 + v4 + v5 + v6", 
                          paste(covars, collapse = " + "),
                          "strata(setnum)", sep = " + ") |> 
  as.formula()


prs_frmla_with_int <- paste("status ~ pfas_lg2_PFHpA*prs_wt_median + v1 + v2 + v3 + v4 + v5 + v6", 
                            paste(covars, collapse = " + "),
                            "strata(setnum)", sep = " + ") |>
  as.formula()



model_no_int   <- clogit(prs_frmla_no_int,   data = data_hcc) 
model_with_int <- clogit(prs_frmla_with_int, data = data_hcc) 
anova(model_no_int, model_with_int)


# Refit final model
(model_with_int <- clogit(prs_frmla_with_int, data = data_hcc, 
                          method = "efron", robust = TRUE)) 

```


# Plot interaction results
```{r}
res <- emtrends(model_with_int, ~prs_wt_median, var = "pfas_lg2_PFHpA", 
                at = list(prs_wt_median = c("1", "2"), 
                          smokestatus_imputed = "Never",
                          q1_d_chol = 0,
                          q1_elih_imputed = 0,
                          q1_fdgp7 = 0,
                          v1 = 0,
                          v2 = 0,
                          v3 = 0,
                          v4 = 0,
                          v5 = 0,
                          v6 = 0)) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  select(prs_wt_median, pfas_lg2_PFHpA.trend, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL) %>%
  rename(estimate = pfas_lg2_PFHpA.trend,
         conf_low = asymp.LCL,
         conf_high = asymp.UCL)%>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(prs_wt_median == "1", 
                       "Low Genetic Risk", 
                       "High Genetic Risk"))

res_pfhpa <- epiomics::owas_clogit(data_hcc , 
                                   cc_set = "setnum", 
                                   cc_status = "status", 
                                   covars = covars,
                                   omics = "pfas_lg2_PFHpA",
                                   conf_int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(type = "Without accounting for genetic risk") %>%
  bind_rows(res) %>%
  mutate(odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
         exp_ci_low = exp(conf_low),
         exp_ci_high = exp(conf_high),
         group = if_else(str_detect(type, "Without"), "overall", "with genetic")) 

(pfhpa_hcc_main <- res_pfhpa  %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(type, 
                          levels = c("High Genetic Risk", 
                                     "Low Genetic Risk", 
                                     "Without accounting for genetic risk")),
               y = exp(estimate))) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = exp(conf_low),
                      ymax = exp(conf_high)),
                  width = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "grey") +
    ylab("Odds Ratio (95% CI)") +
    # ggtitle("Exposure Outcome Analysis for HCC Cases") +
    # facet_grid(.~ factor(type, levels = c("Original Effect Est.", "Effect Est. if reference polymorphism", "Effect Est. if high-risk polymorphism")), scales = "free_y")+
    facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")+
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill="white"), 
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          strip.text.y = element_blank(),
          # strip.text.x = element_blank(),
          text = element_text(size = 12),
          # axis.text.x =element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
          axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.title.y=element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_blank())+
    coord_flip()
)

ggsave(filename = fs::path(dir_figures,
                           "main_figures",
                           "Fig2. Interaction of PFHpA with NAFLD PRS_median.jpeg"),
       width =5,
       height = 2,
       dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")
```

# Analysis 2: All SNPS

* Model1: outcome ~ one pfas + one SNP + pfas * snp
```{r interaction between PFAS and SNPs hcc}
# 1. Set Covariates ----
# Covariates for main exposure outcome associations
covariate_input <- paste(covars, collapse = " + ")

# create dataframe with names of dependent vars (PFAS) 
pfas_names <- tibble(exposure = pfas_name)

## create dataframe with names of SNP vars ----
snp_name <- tibble(snp = snp_name_scld)

pfas_snp <- expand_grid(pfas_names, snp_name) %>%
  mutate(pfas_snp = paste(exposure,"*",snp)) 

# Get Model covariates 
covar_names <- tibble(covariates =  covariate_input)

# 2. Make all clogit formulas ----
ind_vars <- expand_grid(pfas_snp,covar_names) |>  
  mutate(formula = paste("status ~ v1 + v2 + v3 + v4 + v5 + v6",
                         "+", pfas_snp,
                         "+", covariates, 
                         "+strata(setnum)") |>
           str_replace("\\+  \\+", " + "))

ind_vars$clogit_out <- map(
  ind_vars$formula, 
  ~clogit(as.formula(.),
          data = data_analysis_hcc_snp,
          method = "efron",
          robust = TRUE
  ) %>%
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE, level = 0.95) %>% 
    mutate(
      odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
      exp_ci_low = exp(conf.low),
      exp_ci_high = exp(conf.high),
      model_type = "clogit"))

all_results_df_hcc <- ind_vars %>% 
  unnest(clogit_out) %>% 
  dplyr::select(model_type, covariates, everything()) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(p.value < 0.05 ~ "Sig", 
                         p.value >= 0.05 ~ "Not Sig"),
         effect_est = jag2::effest_ci(odds_ratio, exp_ci_low, exp_ci_high))

  # bind_rows(intercept_data) %>% 
  filter(grepl("lg2",term)|grepl("x", term)) %>%
  dplyr::select(exposure, snp, term, p.value, odds_ratio, contains("exp_")) %>%
  mutate(pfas_name = str_remove(exposure, "pfas_lg2_"))


all_results_df_hcc2 <- all_results_df_hcc1 |> 
  mutate(
    effect_type = case_when(str_detect(term, ":")   ~ "PFAS and SNP",
                            str_detect(term, "^x")   ~ "Genetic Risk",
                            TRUE ~ "PFAS")) |>
  filter(!is.na(effect_type)) 


all_results_df_hcc3 <- all_results_df_hcc2 %>% 
  group_by(pfas_name) %>%
  mutate(snp = str_replace_all(snp, "_scld", ""),
         p_adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
         sig = case_when(p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "FDR. Sig.", 
                         p.value < 0.05 ~ "Sig.",
                         TRUE ~ "Not Sig.")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidylog::left_join(snp_info%>%
                       dplyr::select(rsid, snp_name, gene), by = c("snp"="snp_name"))
```

# Examine PFHpA Interaction results
```{r}
pfhpa_gene_interaction <- all_result_new |> 
  tidylog::filter(str_detect(exposure, "PFHpA"), 
                  # effect_type == "PFAS and SNP", 
                  type == "All races") |> 
  mutate(effect_type = fct_relevel(effect_type, 
                                   "PFAS", "Genetic Risk", "PFAS and SNP"))

sig_int <- pfhpa_gene_interaction |> 
  tidylog::filter(effect_type == "PFAS and SNP") 

# save file
# write_csv(sig_int |> select(rsid, genes, p.value), 
#           fs::path(dir_result, "Significant PFHpA x SNP interactions.csv"))

# Create dataset for viewing #
pfhpa_gxe_w <- pfhpa_gene_interaction |> 
  # tidylog::filter(snp %in% sig_int$snp) |>
  tidylog::select(exposure, effect_type,
                  rsid, gene, odds_ratio, p.value, type) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = effect_type, values_from = c(odds_ratio, p.value)) 

pfhpa_gxe_w$`p.value_PFAS and SNP`[pfhpa_gxe_w$gene == "PNPLA3"]
# View(pfhpa_gene_interaction)

# Plot 
pfhpa_gene_interaction |> 
  mutate(gene_snp = str_c(rsid, "\n", gene)) |>
  tidylog::filter(snp %in% sig_int$snp) |>  
  ggplot(aes(x = effect_type, 
             y = odds_ratio, 
             color = p.value < 0.05)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = .3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = exp_ci_low, ymax = exp_ci_high), width = 0) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(~gene_snp) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0)) +
  labs(title = "PFHpA and SNP Interaction",
       x = "Effect",
       y = "Odds Ratio",
       color = "Significance") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey60", "black"))


# Final plot
pfhpa_gene_interaction |> 
  mutate(gene_snp = str_c(rsid, " (", genes, ")", sep = "")) |>
  tidylog::filter(snp %in% sig_int$snp) |>  
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(effect_type), 
             x = odds_ratio)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = .3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = exp_ci_low, xmax = exp_ci_high), width = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~gene_snp, ncol = 1) +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0)) +
  labs(#title = "PFHpA and SNP Interaction",
    y = NULL,
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
    color = "Significance") 
```
